name: Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Lower the bar to mid-chest, then press straight up.

name: Incline Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Bench at 30–45°; lower to the upper chest and press.

name: Decline Bench Press
instructions: Bench tilted head-down; lower to the lower chest and press.

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
instructions: Press the dumbbells up from chest level, bringing them together at the top.

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
instructions: Bench at 30–45°; press the dumbbells up over the upper chest.

name: Machine Chest Press
instructions: Handles at chest height; press forward without locking the elbows.

name: Pec Deck Fly
instructions: Arms slightly bent; bring the pads together in front of the chest.

name: Cable Crossover
instructions: Pull the handles down and together in a wide hugging arc.

name: Dumbbell Fly
instructions: Lying on a bench, open the arms wide with soft elbows, then bring them back up.

name: Push-Up
instructions: Body straight; lower the chest to the floor and push back up.

name: Chest Dip
instructions: Lean forward on the bars and lower until the shoulders are below the elbows.

name: Overhead Barbell Press
instructions: Standing, press the bar from the collarbone to overhead.

name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press
instructions: Seated upright, press the dumbbells from ear level to overhead.

name: Machine Shoulder Press
instructions: Press the handles overhead and lower to shoulder height.

name: Arnold Press
instructions: Start palms facing you; rotate the palms forward as you press up.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
instructions: Raise the dumbbells out to the sides to shoulder height.

name: Cable Lateral Raise
instructions: One arm at a time, raise the handle out to the side to shoulder height.

name: Dumbbell Front Raise
instructions: Raise the dumbbells straight in front to shoulder height.

name: Triceps Pushdown (Rope)
instructions: Elbows pinned to the sides; push the rope down and spread it at the bottom.

name: Triceps Pushdown (Bar)
instructions: Elbows pinned to the sides; push the bar down until the arms are straight.

name: Overhead Cable Triceps Extension
instructions: Facing away from the cable, extend the rope from behind the head to overhead.

name: Dumbbell Overhead Triceps Extension
instructions: Hold one dumbbell overhead with both hands; lower it behind the head and extend.

name: Skull Crusher (EZ Bar)
instructions: Lying down, bend only at the elbows to lower the bar to the forehead, then extend.

name: Close-Grip Bench Press
instructions: Hands shoulder-width; keep the elbows close as you press.

name: Bench Dip
instructions: Hands on a bench behind you; lower the hips by bending the elbows, then push up.

name: Lat Pulldown (Wide Grip)
instructions: Pull the bar to the upper chest, leading with the elbows.

name: Close-Grip Lat Pulldown (V-Bar)
instructions: Pull the V-handle to the upper chest, squeezing the shoulder blades.

name: Pull-Up
instructions: Overhand grip; pull until the chin is over the bar.

name: Chin-Up
instructions: Underhand grip; pull until the chin is over the bar.

name: Seated Cable Row
instructions: Sit tall and pull the handle to the stomach, squeezing the shoulder blades.

name: Barbell Bent-Over Row
instructions: Hinge forward with a flat back; row the bar to the lower ribs.

name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
instructions: One hand and knee on a bench; row the dumbbell to the hip.

name: T-Bar Row
instructions: Chest over the bar; row the handles to the chest.

name: Chest-Supported Machine Row
instructions: Chest on the pad; pull the handles back, squeezing the shoulder blades.

name: Straight-Arm Pulldown
instructions: Arms nearly straight; sweep the bar down to the thighs.

name: Face Pull
instructions: Rope at face height; pull it towards the forehead, hands ending beside the ears.

name: Reverse Pec Deck
instructions: Facing the pad, open the arms back in a wide arc.

name: Barbell Shrug
instructions: Hold the bar at arm's length and lift the shoulders straight up.

name: Dumbbell Shrug
instructions: Dumbbells at the sides; lift the shoulders straight up.

name: Deadlift
instructions: Flat back; push the floor away and stand up with the bar close to the legs.

name: Back Extension (Hyperextension)
instructions: Hips on the pad; lower the upper body and raise it back to a straight line.

name: Barbell Curl
instructions: Elbows at the sides; curl the bar to the shoulders.

name: Dumbbell Curl
instructions: Curl the dumbbells up, turning the palms to face you.

name: Hammer Curl
instructions: Palms facing each other; curl the dumbbells up.

name: Preacher Curl (EZ Bar)
instructions: Upper arms on the preacher pad; curl the bar up and lower it fully.

name: Cable Curl
instructions: Facing the cable, curl the bar up with the elbows fixed.

name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
instructions: Lying back on an incline bench, curl with the arms hanging behind the body.

name: Barbell Back Squat
instructions: Bar on the upper back; sit down until the thighs are level, then stand.

name: Front Squat
instructions: Bar on the front of the shoulders; squat with an upright chest.

name: Leg Press
instructions: Lower the platform until the knees are bent about 90°, then press.

name: Hack Squat
instructions: Back on the pad; squat down and drive back up.

name: Goblet Squat
instructions: Hold a dumbbell at the chest and squat between the knees.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Back foot on a bench; lower the back knee towards the floor.

name: Walking Lunge
instructions: Step forward and lower the back knee, then step through to the next lunge.

name: Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Soft knees; push the hips back and lower the bar along the legs.

name: Leg Extension
instructions: Straighten the legs against the pad, then lower slowly.

name: Lying Leg Curl
instructions: Face down; curl the pad towards the glutes.

name: Seated Leg Curl
instructions: Seated; curl the pad down and back under the seat.

name: Barbell Hip Thrust
instructions: Upper back on a bench, bar on the hips; drive the hips up to a straight line.

name: Standing Calf Raise
instructions: Rise onto the toes as high as possible, then lower the heels below the step.

name: Seated Calf Raise
instructions: Knees under the pad; raise the heels as high as possible.

name: Hip Abduction Machine
instructions: Push the knees outwards against the pads.

name: Hip Adduction Machine
instructions: Squeeze the knees together against the pads.

name: Plank
instructions: Forearms and toes on the floor; hold the body in a straight line.

name: Side Plank
instructions: On one forearm and the side of the foot; hold the hips up.

name: Crunch
instructions: Lying on your back, curl the shoulders up towards the hips.

name: Cable Crunch
instructions: Kneeling, hold the rope by the head and crunch down towards the knees.

name: Hanging Leg Raise
instructions: Hanging from a bar, raise the legs to hip height or higher.

name: Lying Leg Raise
instructions: Lying flat, raise straight legs to vertical and lower without touching the floor.

name: Russian Twist
instructions: Seated and leaning back, rotate the torso side to side. Count each side as one rep.

name: Ab Wheel Rollout
instructions: Kneeling, roll the wheel forward as far as you can control, then roll back.

name: Bicycle Crunch
instructions: Bring each elbow towards the opposite knee, alternating sides.

name: Mountain Climber
instructions: In a push-up position, drive the knees towards the chest in turn.

name: Treadmill Run
instructions: Level is the speed in km/h.

name: Treadmill Incline Walk
instructions: Level is the incline in %.

name: Outdoor Run
instructions: Log time and distance to see your pace.

name: Outdoor Walk
instructions: Log time and distance to see your pace.

name: Stationary Bike
instructions: Level is the machine's resistance level.

name: Outdoor Cycling
instructions: Log time and distance.

name: Elliptical
instructions: Level is the machine's resistance level.

name: Rowing Machine
instructions: Drive with the legs first, then pull the handle to the ribs.

name: Stair Climber
instructions: Level is the machine's speed level.

name: Skipping Rope
instructions: Log the total time.

name: Swimming
instructions: Log time and distance.
